narrative: This daily brief synthesizes key developments across technology, AI, and education. Highlights include nationwide emergency alert tests, significant investments in brain technology, and Nvidia's strategic shift towards national security. Concerns about AI autonomy are rising, while efforts to democratize computer science education continue.
